name: Andou Miyako
source:
Miyako, a second year student at Rokukeikan Academy and [url=https://vndb.org/c43551]Keisuke[/url]'s classmate, is the no nonsense Classroom Representative with a perfect grade point average and high aspirations for the future. She holds steady to her convictions and refuses to compromise when the rules of the Game are explained.

[Edited from erogereview and [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=141]MangaGamer[/url]]
